direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-05-rcs-28809-adarsh
direct_evidence.body:
Hi Adarsh, quick one on Kohl's, client 092, RCS-28809.

ARDM_PRODUCTION.C092_KHL.REFERENCE_EMPLOYEE keeps the old row when an associate transfers stores. Each transfer inserts a new row for the new locationid and the previous row stays with its last updateddatetime. Today 1402 employeeids have more than one row, up from 227 on Sep 8.

Employeeid 3029046 has locationid 813 inserted 2026-09-22 and updated 2026-10-05, and locationid 826 inserted 2026-09-29 and last updated 2026-10-04. Employeeid 2678276 has locationid 437 last updated 2026-10-04 and locationid 1123 inserted 2026-10-05 08:08:39.

It looks like the job upserts on employeeid plus locationid. Can you confirm the key it uses? If that is right, could it upsert on employeeid alone and remove the older rows? The current row per employee is the one with the latest updateddatetime. Inserteddatetime picks the wrong row for 3029046.

The customer sees every store listed for the same associate and their Work Items flag in each one. I can send the full list of affected employeeids. Happy to jump on a short call if that is easier.
